answer_1.quote: We introduce a large-scale benchmark with (1) paired sentences undergoing 21 finegrained stylistic changes spanning the most atomic lexical, syntactic, semantic, and thematic style constructs, as well as (2) compositions of multiple transfers which model how fine-grained style constructs compose to form more complex, high-level transfers.
answer_1.outputs: paraphrased sentences with fine-grained stylistic modifications

answer_2.quote: Automated evaluation metrics consists of automatic BLEU scores, METEOR scores, ROUGE_L scores, and CiDER scores between generated and ground truth sentences.

answer_4.quote: we had 2 independent annotators each rate transferred sentences on three aspects (clarity/grammar, content preservation, style change) on a 1 -5 Likert scale, and takes average.
answer_4.guideline: rate transferred sentences on three aspects (clarity/grammar, content preservation, style change) on a 1 -5 Likert scale
